bureau: Credit Information Bureau of Sri Lanka (CRIB)
note: CRIB's questions and answers: a lender reports a borrower's new status at the end of the month, a monthly cycle with no threshold, written as 30 days; a borrower's credit information stays in the report five years after full settlement.

sources.title: CRIB, Help desk: FAQs
sources.said: When you settle your loan or pay the arrears in full, the new status will be reported to the Bureau by your lending institution at the end of that month. ... The Credit Information of a Borrower is retained in the report for 5 years after the full settlement.
